description:
Call this BEFORE running any command that installs or runs a dependency: npm/yarn/pnpm/bun install, npx, pip/uv/poetry/pipx, cargo add, go get, dotnet add package, gem install, composer require, dart pub add, docker pull/run, git clone.

Language models invent plausible package names that have never existed, and attackers register those names because they can predict them (slopsquatting). Installing one runs attacker code. You cannot tell by looking at the name.

Pass the command exactly as you intend to run it. Decision: ALLOW (run it), REVIEW (tell the user about the risk signals first), BLOCK (do not run; use `successor` if given, otherwise tell the user), UNVERIFIED (registry unreachable; do not treat as safe).

command.description: The shell command, verbatim. Example: pip install requests requests-oauth2-helper

model.description: Optional: the model that produced these names (e.g. claude-opus-5-5). With an API key this attests absent names to the public hallucination ledger.

name: hallux_check_command
